## Episode Thesis

This episode of the Rika Tillsammans podcast is about personal finance, not stocks. It looks at how much wealth Swedes have, using UBS's Global Wealth Report, ISK account data bought from Statistics Sweden, surveys (Infostat, SBAB, Nordnet/YouGov) and customer data from Avanza and Lysa. The median Swede holds about 90,000 kr on an ISK, wealth is very unevenly spread, and many households have thin savings buffers, while Sweden still ranks high on median wealth worldwide. Companies come up only as data sources, sponsors or comparisons, so there are no investment views or buy/sell calls.
